original_test_intent: The title requests OS installation, while Procedure and Criteria only request verification that a TPM setting can be revised. These are materially different operations and must remain a recorded source conflict.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Verify can revise TPM setting or not.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: Verify can revise TPM setting or not.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; assumed a clean OS install with TPM enabled and post-install Linux TPM readback.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED because the TPM setting, state transition, OS image, disk and success definition were absent.
historical_reviews.v3: SOURCE_CONFLICT plus REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION; manual BIOS/installer activity and automated post-install evidence remain separable.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Engineer selects and operates the approved BIOS/installer path and exact installation target; agent may collect the approved post-install TPM/boot evidence.
required_user_inputs: Project decision: OS installation, TPM-setting revision, or both
Exact TPM control and start/final state
OS image/version and dedicated installation target
Backup, key, Secure Boot and reimage recovery plan

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: Preserve both the 'OS installing' title and the TPM-setting Procedure/Criteria; 5/20-minute values are planning metadata, not a resolved install duration.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Engineer explicitly defines current project scope, image, target, TPM transition and evidence.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: A project choice can authorize one scope but cannot erase the other conflicting master statement; the omitted intent remains unresolved in the Master Library.

original_method: Manual BIOS/installer interaction followed by OS TPM checks. DeepSeek's fixed Linux commands are historical suggestions, not authoritative source commands.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the project's existing OS deployment workflow and platform-qualified TPM tooling only after scope resolution.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: OS/platform vendor documentation must match the selected image and TPM implementation; no universal command is asserted.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original: Adds repeatable deployment/readback but cannot resolve whether OS install is actually in scope.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: TPM device enumeration alone does not prove OS installation, TPM setting revision, ownership, measured boot or application use.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Installation is destructive to the selected disk and TPM/boot-policy changes can affect keys and bootability.

safety_boundaries: Never infer or choose the installation disk.
Do not clear/own TPM, alter keys or change Secure Boot without explicit scope and recovery.
Preserve logs and storage identity evidence.
expected_evidence: Post-install OS, TPM, boot, BMC/SEL and recovery evidence
no_automatic_retry: A failed install, TPM change or boot is preserved. Reimage, firmware/setup changes or another install attempt require a new approved recovery/run plan.
engineer_owned_verdict: Agent reports install and TPM evidence and the unresolved master conflict; only the engineer assigns formal verdict.
review_improvement: KEEP because V3 already preserves the Items-versus-Procedure conflict and treats installation/TPM inputs as readiness gates. V3.1 clarifies that a project scope decision governs only that run and does not silently repair the Master Library.
